variaciones.cambio: Usar este prompt tal cual: Vertical smartphone photo, amateur and candid, slightly grainy, taken inside a small supplement fulfillment warehouse in Latin America. Fluorescent ceiling lights, white walls. In the foreground, on a stainless steel packing table, a worker's hands in blue nitrile gloves are placing 3 amber glass dropper bottles (2 fl oz, black dropper cap, yellow and white label reading "VITALDROPS", All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement) into a plain kraft cardboard shipping box with crinkle paper filling. Next to it is a printed shipping label and a roll of packing tape. In the background are metal shelves full of brown boxes and dozens of rows of the same amber VitalDrops bottles lined up on the table. Two or three workers in gray t-shirts are packing out of focus. Natural, imperfect framing, handheld phone look, no studio lighting, realistic, not glossy. No text overlays, no captions, no watermarks.

acciones.indicaciones: Seguir el prompt del usuario al pie de la letra. El frasco debe ser igual al de la foto del producto VITALDROPS. Nada de texto, titulares, precios, botones ni marcas de agua sobre la imagen. Look de foto de celular real, no de estudio.
